meta.description: Build publication-quality figures with matplotlib using the OO Figure/Axes API, constrained layout, Type-42 font embedding and CVD-safe palettes, with seaborn integration; ships scripts/matplotlib_phd.py.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; the shipped example uses labelled synthetic data. On real airway results (541 Up / 497 Down / 17,200 NS) the Skill's list-palette recipe drew correct points but with data-order-dependent colours (MPL-002), filed as a defect.

practice_boundaries.detail: Plotting skill; no clinical or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy; colour-to-class binding by list order is a presentation hazard (MPL-002), not an inverted statistical conclusion.

code_usability.detail: matplotlib_phd.py and every recipe ran unchanged on matplotlib 3.11.2 with exit 0; defects are page size, palette binding and doc claims (MPL-001..MPL-006).

functional_suitability.note: Covers rcParams, OO API, layout, fonts, saving and seaborn; the shipped rcParams break the 89 mm promise (MPL-001) and the list-palette recipe mis-binds colours (MPL-002).

reliability.note: All shipped code runs cleanly on 3.11.2 with no warnings; behaviour hazards are silent (page size, palette order).

performance_context.note: Compact SKILL.md routing to two references; recipes and guardrails repeat across SKILL.md, usage-guide and failure-modes.

agent_usability.note: Clear defaults and guardrails; an agent following the Standard Setup gets 89.4 mm output while the script gives 92.0 mm (MPL-001).

human_usability.note: Readable; usage-guide mixes pyplot calls into an OO-API Skill (MPL-006).

security.note: Local file writes only; no credentials or network.

maintainability.note: Single example script mirrors SKILL.md; no tests or palette-binding checks.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routed references; failure-modes.md contains a nonexistent method and an exaggerated size claim (MPL-003).

recommendations.title: MPL-001 Shipped rcParams do not yield the documented 89/180 mm journal widths
recommendations.problem: savefig.bbox='tight' re-crops the canvas: matplotlib_phd.py writes 92.0, 91.8 and 182.7 mm pages for 89, 89 and 180 mm figures (default pad 0.1 in is not set); the SKILL.md Standard Setup gives 89.4 mm.
recommendations.root_cause: bbox_inches='tight' overrides figsize; the script omits savefig.pad_inches.
recommendations.fix: Drop savefig.bbox='tight' (constrained layout already prevents clipping) from both the Standard Setup and script, or document the size change and assert page width.

recommendations.title: MPL-002 List palettes bind colours to data order, not to Up/Down/NS
recommendations.problem: palette=['#999999','#0072B2','#D55E00'] with hue='significance' draws Up blue and Down orange on real airway data and 'ns' orange in the shipped example; the colour-to-class mapping depends on row order and the same list in seaborn.objects.
recommendations.root_cause: seaborn maps a list palette to hue levels in order of appearance.
recommendations.fix: Use palette={'NS':..., 'Down':..., 'Up':...} with hue_order in SKILL.md, matplotlib_phd.py and seaborn.objects scale.

recommendations.title: MPL-003 failure-modes.md contains a nonexistent method and an exaggerated claim
recommendations.problem: `fig.set_rasterization_zorder(0)` raises AttributeError (it is `ax.set_rasterization_zorder`); '100000 points = 50 MB PDF, 30 s open' is not reproduced (19k points = 0.27 MB); 'default rasterization can include axes' is not demonstrated.
recommendations.fix: Use ax.set_rasterization_zorder(0), restate the size effect with a measured ratio, drop the vague mechanism.

recommendations.title: MPL-004 'SVG for editable vector' leaves text as paths
recommendations.problem: svg.fonttype defaults to 'path': the saved SVG has 0 <text> elements and 55 glyph uses, so text is not editable.
recommendations.root_cause: Saving block does not set svg.fonttype.
recommendations.fix: Set svg.fonttype='none' (with a note that fonts must be installed) or reword the claim.

recommendations.title: MPL-005 Example styling departs from the Skill's own rules
recommendations.problem: The cluster scatter uses cmap='tab10' (not CVD-safe) against the Okabe-Ito requirement; axes.titlesize=8 exceeds the stated 5-7 pt body-text limit; the grid titles repeat the panel tags a-f.
recommendations.root_cause: Example written before the CVD and size rules.
recommendations.fix: Colour clusters with the Okabe-Ito list, use titlesize 7, and drop the redundant panel titles.

recommendations.title: MPL-006 OO-API Skill mixes pyplot state calls
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md Color section uses plt.imshow/plt.colorbar and the recipes use plt.colorbar(..., ax=ax) while the guardrail forbids pyplot state calls after plt.subplots(n, m).
recommendations.root_cause: Snippets not rewritten to the OO form.
recommendations.fix: Use ax.imshow and fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax) in SKILL.md, usage-guide and chart-recipes.
